meta.promptText: Which moisturizer should I buy for dry skin in Indian winters?

response.text:
For **dry skin in Indian winters**, I’d prioritize a **cream with ceramides + humectants (glycerin/hyaluronic acid)** rather than a lightweight gel. Winter’s lower humidity can weaken the skin barrier and increase water loss. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My top picks

### [CeraVe Moisturising Cream]()
*₹356*

### [Cetaphil DAM Daily Advance Ultra Hydrating Lotion]()
*₹630*

### [Bioderma Atoderm Creme Ultra-Nourishing Cream]()
*₹629*

### [Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser]()
*₹266*

**🥇 Best overall: CeraVe Moisturising Cream**  
Especially good if your skin gets **very dry, flaky, tight, or irritated**. It contains ceramides and hyaluronic acid and is a particularly good winter barrier-repair choice. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/10-best-barrier-repair-creams-for-indian-winters-that-truly-heal-dry-skin-10792239?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/beauty-blog/top-moisturizer-for-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 Best value: Cetaphil DAM**  
A great everyday option if you want something rich but not quite as heavy. It uses ingredients including shea butter, glycerin and panthenol. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥉 Best for very dry/sensitive skin: Bioderma Atoderm**  
A richer option for skin that gets extremely dry during winter.

**💰 Good Indian-brand option: Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser**  
Worth considering if you want a more affordable ceramide-based option.

**If I had to pick just one:** **CeraVe Moisturising Cream** for genuinely dry winter skin. Apply it to **slightly damp skin**, ideally soon after washing, to help retain moisture. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/10-best-barrier-repair-creams-for-indian-winters-that-truly-heal-dry-skin-10792239?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/beauty-blog/top-moisturizer-for-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. under ₹300/₹500/₹1000)** and whether your skin is **dry + acne-prone or just dry**, I can narrow it down to the best 1–2 choices.
